prompt: The crying boy (say / tell) the shopkeeper that his lost gray parrot had a red ring on its left leg.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell (в прошедшем времени told) обязательно ставится прямое дополнение — адресат сообщения (told the shopkeeper that...).

prompt: The printed recipe (say / tell) to let the roasted chicken rest under foil for ten minutes before slicing.
explanation_ru: Для передачи содержания письменного текста или инструкции без указания конкретного адресата используется глагол say (the recipe says to do something).

prompt: The officer thanked the resident for turning in the lost wallet and asked her to (say / tell) him her phone number.
explanation_ru: Конструкция tell + лицо + прямой объект (tell him her phone number) требует глагола tell, так как указан адресат.

prompt: The driver stopped our car and (say / tell) that the forest ranger had spotted a wild boar family near the river trail.
explanation_ru: Если сразу после глагола речи идет придаточное с that без указания слушателя, используется глагол say (said that...).

prompt: My uncle carefully (say / tell) me how to oil the rusty bicycle chain without getting grease on my hands.
explanation_ru: Глагол tell используется в модели tell + лицо + вопросительное слово + инфинитив (told me how to oil).

prompt: In her online review, the food blogger (say / tell) that the mango sticky rice stall near the river entrance serves the best dessert in town.
explanation_ru: Когда приводится содержание отзыва без упоминания конкретного адресата, употребляется глагол say с придаточным that.

prompt: Our roommate just messaged me and (say / tell) us to bring extra ice and paper cups to the party.
explanation_ru: Для передачи просьбы или распоряжения с указанием получателя используется модель tell + дополнение + to-инфинитив (told us to bring).

prompt: Seeing the tourist's hand gestures, the helpful pharmacist began to (speak / talk) English and found the right eye drops.
explanation_ru: С названиями иностранных языков (English) в значении «владеть/говорить на языке» употребляется только глагол speak.

prompt: The pottery expert (say / tell) the junior restorer to dry the wet wooden bowl slowly in a shaded room.
explanation_ru: Конструкция «велеть/посоветовать кому-либо сделать что-либо» требует глагола tell с прямым дополнением и инфинитивом (told the junior restorer to dry).

prompt: I bought three postcards in the museum gift shop yesterday. My review (say / tell) that the printed colors look nothing like the real paintings upstairs. I even (speak / talk) to the manager about the poor print quality before leaving.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске содержание текста передается через say (says that...) без адресата. Во втором — для разговора с человеком с предлогом to подходят глаголы speak и talk.

prompt: Before lighting the Bunsen burners, the chemistry teacher (say / tell) us to put on our safety glasses. He also (say / tell) that loose hair must be tied back near an open flame. Everyone listened carefully because safety rules in the lab are strict.
explanation_ru: В первом предложении есть прямое дополнение и инфинитив (told us to put on), поэтому нужен глагол tell. Во втором сразу идет придаточное that без адресата, поэтому используется said.

prompt: During the lab experiment, Leo noticed the liquid in their beaker had turned bright pink instead of clear. He quickly (say / tell) his lab partner not to panic before the professor walked over. Then Leo (say / tell) to the professor that they had added one extra drop of indicator.
explanation_ru: С прямым дополнением и инфинитивом (told his lab partner not to panic) ставится tell, а с предлогом to перед адресатом (said to the professor) используется say.

prompt: Dad wanted to buy a pair of cheap wireless headphones online. His teenage son read the top customer review aloud, which (say / tell) that the bass sounds muddy and the battery dies fast. After hearing that, Dad agreed to (speak / talk) about better models with the store clerk.
explanation_ru: В первом случае отзыв цитируется через конструкцию say + that. Во втором для обсуждения темы с предлогом about используются talk или speak.

prompt: Grandpa accidentally uploaded a blurry photo of his thumb as his new profile picture. His granddaughter laughed and (say / tell) him how to delete it from his phone. Grandpa (say / tell) that touchscreen buttons are still confusing for him.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске используется структура tell + лицо + how to (told him how to delete), а во втором — say + придаточное that без указания слушателя.

prompt: Stuck in heavy gridlock on the bridge, the passenger phoned his office and ___ his manager that he would arrive twenty minutes late.
explanation_ru: После глагола сразу следует прямое дополнение без предлога (his manager) и придаточное that, что требует глагола told.

prompt: The wooden sign near the park entrance ___ that the river path is closed because a fallen oak tree blocks the bridge.
explanation_ru: Для передачи содержания надписи или объявления (the sign says that...) используется глагол say.

prompt: In his morning email, the client ___ the contractor to change the roof color back to the original grey.
explanation_ru: Конструкция с прямым дополнением и инфинитивом (told the contractor to change) требует глагола tell.

prompt: The resident came to the police station and ___ the officer that someone had stolen his garden gnome overnight.
explanation_ru: Поскольку сразу после глагола без предлога указан собеседник (the officer), необходимо выбрать told.

prompt: At midnight, the exhausted parents whispered about what the pediatrician had said them to do about the baby's sleep schedule.
answer: At midnight, the exhausted parents whispered about what the pediatrician had told them to do about the baby's sleep schedule.
accepted_answers: At midnight, the exhausted parents whispered about what the pediatrician had told them to do about the baby's sleep schedule.
explanation_ru: Ошибка в выборе глагола: перед прямым дополнением и инфинитивом (them to do) вместо said используется told.

prompt: The office manager sent an email that told to all staff members to label their lunch boxes before Friday evening.
answer: The office manager sent an email that told all staff members to label their lunch boxes before Friday evening.
accepted_answers: The office manager sent an email that told all staff members to label their lunch boxes before Friday evening.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell предлог to перед адресатом не ставится: правильно told all staff members to label.

prompt: The host sent a clear message that told us how to find the hidden garden gate behind the tall blue garage.
answer: The host sent a clear message that told us how to find the hidden garden gate behind the tall blue garage.
accepted_answers: The host sent a clear message that told us how to find the hidden garden gate behind the tall blue garage.
explanation_ru: Предложение построено верно: использована правильная конструкция told + прямое дополнение + how to find.

prompt: A blood donor feels dizzy after giving blood and drops his juice box, so the nurse reacts immediately.
options: The nurse said him to sit down on the chair and brought another snack.
The nurse told to him to sit down on the chair and brought another snack.
The nurse told him to sit down on the chair and brought another snack.
The nurse spoke him to sit down on the chair and brought another snack.
explanation_ru: Единственно верная модель для выражения распоряжения или совета с адресатом — tell + прямое дополнение без предлога + to-инфинитив (told him to sit down).

prompt: Rewrite using told instead of said to: The gallery guard said to the visitor that the blank white canvas was an expensive painting.
answer: The gallery guard told the visitor that the blank white canvas was an expensive painting.
accepted_answers: The gallery guard told the visitor that the blank white canvas was an expensive painting.
explanation_ru: При замене said to на told предлог to опускается, так как глагол tell требует прямого дополнения (told the visitor that...).
